source.title: Cefazolin in Chronic Hemodialysis Patients: A Safe, Effective Alternative to Vancomycin

consistency_review.finding: Table 1 reports all-culture cefazolin-plus-gentamicin coverage as 175 of 225 and 50%; the printed count and percentage are inconsistent and were preserved without correction.

extraction_limitations: Microbiology effectiveness comparisons are based on in vitro culture susceptibility, not randomized comparative clinical outcomes.
Positive cultures were not adjudicated as infection, colonization, or contamination.
The pharmacokinetic cohort was small and limited to anuric patients using an F80 polysulfone dialyzer.
No cefazolin-treated study patient had bacteremia during the study period.
The study did not measure cefazolin MICs.
The article does not report a modern conflict-of-interest, funding, or data-availability statement.
schema_gaps: The model has no dedicated field for standard deviation, so SD values are preserved in canonical statements and original_result_text.
The model has no dedicated source-integrity discrepancy object; the Table 1 count/percentage inconsistency is represented as atom_kind=other with explicit tags.
